kind: data property: paper-to-venue ranking accuracy on held-out 2025 abstracts (machine independent)
design: pre-registered; settings chosen on the even half of the queries, reported on the odd half; profiles from 2020-2024, queries are 2025 abstracts (Semantic Scholar, Crossref; not published); 324 venues ranked

shipped_variant.fusion: weighted sum, each channel divided by the query's best score

notes: The test half was read twice: once in the final run and once after a data fix (COLING source voting); the second read, reported here, changed no weight and no guard result.
Variants with OpenAlex abstracts (A2) or Crossref and Semantic Scholar (Ac, comparison only) gain more but fail the title-query guard; they are not published.
The published file is built for 2021-2025 (2025 added, 2020 dropped) with the same code; the module reproduces the study's ranks on all but 1 of 4,806 queries (rounding of published weights).
Ten terms in the counts were removed by the repository's withheld-term filter before publishing; the channels already excluded them (identical channel weights).
